notes.title: Last Chance to Cozy Up in the Estuary! Playtest Ends Soon! 📢
notes.content:
Just a friendly reminder that the Welcome: A Cozy Estuary playtest is coming to a close on Monday, January 6th.  Don't miss your chance to explore the charming world of the Welcome Universe and help shape the game with your feedback! 🏡✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333394/da73a932c860d1ec53d615bebc705255ea2dc0cf.jpg

Here's what you can still do before the playtest ends:


 Request Access: If you haven't already, head over to our Steam page and click "Request Access" under "Join the Playtest."
 Share Your Feedback: We want to hear from every playtester! Fill out our feedback survey and let us know your thoughts
 Spread the Word: Tell your friends about the playtest and invite them to join the fun!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333394/f6180b62a1729d309a56b42eb7abcd8eeb7c644f.jpg

We're incredibly grateful to everyone who has participated in the playtest so far. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we can't wait to use it to make Welcome: A Cozy Estuary the coziest game ever! 💖

Warmly,
The Titan1Studios Team
MyEstuary.com

notes.title: Welcome: A Cozy Estuary Playtest is LIVE! 🎉
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that the playtest for Welcome: A Cozy Estuary is officially LIVE on Steam! 🦀✨

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333394/776907634d4f307e61a502436d7447ef65dfc945.jpg

Welcome: A Cozy Estuary is a charming neighbourvania game inspired by the heartwarming Welcome Animated Series.  Meet familiar faces, explore a beautiful estuary environment, build your dream home, and craft your way to cozy perfection. 🏡💖

Playtest Features:


 ~1 hour of gameplay showcasing core mechanics: questing, farming, fishing, collecting, and exploring with controller and multi-language (English, French, Spanish) support!
 A glimpse into the story and characters of the Estuary.
 A chance to provide valuable feedback and shape the game's development.


Ready to dive in?


 Head over to our Steam page
 Click "Request Access" under "Join the Playtest"
 Keep an eye out for an email notification!


Roadmap:

We're still in the early development phase. This playtest focuses on gameplay basics. Here's a peek at what's coming next:


 Expanding the Estuary: More areas to explore, including the aquatic and treetop towns.
 Deeper Story: Uncover the mysteries of the Estuary and connect with its quirky inhabitants.
 New Activities: Crafting, Cooking, Mining, Logging, Bug Catching and more!
 Community Features: Interact with other characters, trade items, and build relationships.
 Decoration and Customization: Decorate your own Estuary! Place new objects or move any building around. Decorate inside your home or dress up your character.


Known Issues:

We're still polishing things up! Here are some known issues in this playtest:


 Occasional frame rate drops: We're optimizing performance, especially in busy areas.
 Minor text glitches: A few typos and formatting issues might sneak in.
 Character animations: Facial expressions are still being refined (thanks for the feedback!).


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45333394/771dcb617259c5af91bdee3f6dad3124bfb63931.jpg

Your Feedback is Essential!

We want to hear from every playtester! Please take a few minutes to share your thoughts in our survey:

HERE

Your feedback is invaluable in making Welcome: A Cozy Estuary the coziest game ever!  Let us know about your favorite moments, any bugs you encountered, and what you'd love to see in the future. 😊

Warmly,
The team at Titan1Studios
MyEstuary.com
